name: SDK CI

on:

    branches:

jobs:
  version-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

          pip install --upgrade pip

  sdk-generation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install @hey-api/openapi-ts
      - name: Generate SDK
        run: uvicorn run.server:sdk_generate --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

  publish-python:
    needs: version-validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install hatchling
      - name: Publish Python package
        run: hatch publish

  publish-typescript:
    needs: version-validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [14, 16]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      - name: Run type check
        run: pnpm run typecheck
      - name: Build SDK
        run: pnpm run build:sdk
      - name: Publish TypeScript package
        run: pnpm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

yaml:
name: SDK CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  version-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pyyaml
      - name: Validate version
        run: |
          python scripts/validate_version.py

  sdk-generation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install @hey-api/openapi-ts
      - name: Generate SDK
        run: uvicorn run.server:sdk_generate --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

  publish-python:
    needs: version-validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install hatchling
      - name: Publish Python package
        run: hatch publish

  publish-typescript:
    needs: version-validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [14, 16]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      - name: Run type check
        run: pnpm run typecheck
      - name: Build SDK
        run: pnpm run build:sdk
      - name: Publish TypeScript package
        run: pnpm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
